title: Candle Holder
description: This product was designed around how visceral products from the likes of Claustrum feel to me: the denotations and connotations of the material presented, from the feeling of handling its slick finish to the sounds it makes when colliding with itself.

brief.label: Inspiration
brief.text: The sensory feel of objects from the likes of Claustrum: a slick finish, and the sound the material makes.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: A folded metal sheet with a slotted face that holds a pillar candle, documented from technical drawing to finished renders.

study_intro: A study of how a material feels: the slick finish in the hand and the sound it makes against itself, after objects from the likes of Claustrum.

study.label: Form
study.text: A folded sheet that becomes a stand, with a slotted face that throws patterned light.

study.label: Material
study.text: Mirror-polished gold metal on terrazzo: reflection against speckle.

study.label: Detail
study.text: Documented first as a technical drawing (CH001), so the fold lines and slots read as precisely as the renders.
